title: Graduate Trainee Program
description: Stanbic Bank Uganda is recruiting fresh graduates for its 12-month graduate trainee program in banking operations, credit, and digital financial services. Open to first-class and second-class-upper graduates.

title: Internship: Civil Engineering (Roads)
description: UNRA is offering 6-month paid internships to final-year civil engineering students. Work on live road upgrading projects in central Uganda. Good written communication and AutoCAD skills required.

title: Full Sponsorship: BSc Nursing
location: Mbarara University of Science and Technology
description: The HOSA Scholarship Fund is offering full sponsorship for one female former Highway student to pursue a BSc in Nursing at MUST. Covers tuition, accommodation, and books for four years. Awarded on merit and financial need.

title: Sales Representative – FMCG
description: Movit is hiring a sales representative for the western Uganda region. Requires a diploma or degree, a valid driving licence, and willingness to travel. Competitive salary plus commission.

title: Volunteer Teachers (S.1–S.4)
description: The school is seeking volunteer teachers for Mathematics, Physics, and English for the 2026 academic year. Ideal for recent graduates awaiting posting or retired teachers who want to give back.
